summaryJa: 機種コールサイン1.4aによる偵察ミッション（ATO: AP、ミッション番号1.4a、作戦: INHERENT RESOLVE）。2022年5月20日（DTG表記）0542ZにOKASを通信問題で遅れて離陸、0551ZにLREからハンドオーバーを受け、0614Z–2346ZにかけてAIRHANDLER VERSION 2で信号インテリジェンスを収集。0927Z–2121ZにMAG支援（OP PHANTOM FLEX）でFMVおよびSIを実施、2121ZにRTBを許可され、0005ZにLREへ返還、0036ZにOKAS着陸。合計機上時間18時間54分、ステーション滞在時間18時間14分。事前調整は離陸136分前に実施され「満足」と評価。FMVはDGS 1で解析、任務は有効と報告され、情報ギャップは埋まった。UAP接触は2022年5月20日2043Zに記録され、北から北東へ飛行する1対象を追跡したが確定識別できず。機密区分はSECRET//REL TO USA, FVEY（再分類解除日: 2025-10-08）。
summaryEn: Reconnaissance mission by callsign 1.4a (ATO: AP, mission 1.4a) under Operation INHERENT RESOLVE. Took off late from OKAS at 0542Z on 20 May 2022 due to communications issues, handed over from LRE at 0551Z. Collected SIGINT via AIRHANDLER VERSION 2 from 0614Z to 2346Z. Supported MAG (OP PHANTOM FLEX) conducting FMV and signals intelligence from 0927Z to 2121Z; cleared to RTB at 2121Z, handed back to LRE at 0005Z, landed at OKAS at 0036Z. Total mission time 18h54m, time on station 18h14m. Precoordination with MAG occurred 136 minutes prior to takeoff and was assessed as satisfactory. FMV was exploited by DGS 1; mission assessed as effective and filled intel gaps. A single UAP was observed at 2043Z on 20 May 2022 moving north to northeast and was followed as long as possible, but the screener could not positively identify it. Classification: SECRET//REL TO USA, FVEY (declassified 08 Oct 2025).
